---
title: "Carbon Isotope Regression Sensitivity Analysis"
output: html_notebook
## This script determines the robustness of the two endmembers and the slope of a linear regression two endmember mixing model.
---
Load in packages and data
```{r setup}
required_packages <- c(
  "tidyverse",
  "MCMCglmm",
  "cowplot",
  "readxl",
  "BSDA",
  "scales"
)

# Install any packages that are not yet installed
new_packages <- required_packages[!(required_packages %in% installed.packages()[,"Package"])]
if(length(new_packages)) {
  install.packages(new_packages, dependencies = TRUE)
}

# Load all packages
lapply(required_packages, library, character.only = TRUE)

RegressionData <- as_tibble(read_excel("<data path>")) # path to regression data in .xlsx table

# parameters for plotting figures
cap_width <- .01 
titlesize <- 12
labelsize <- 4
axis_text <- 11


SimNum <- 5000 # number or iterations for Monte Carlo simulation. Lower to decrease run time 
RSD <- c(1e-8,.025,.05,.075,.1,.125,.15,.175,.2,.225,.25,.275,.3,.325,.35) # Steps for magnitude of random normalized error. First step is negligibly small to prevent divide by 0

set.seed(12345) # set seed for reproducible results
```

Run Monte Carlo Simulation for Samples 14C
```{r}
length = length(RegressionData$C14)
c=1
df <- length(RegressionData$HS) - 2 #degrees of freedom
tcrit <- qt(0.975, df) # determines t-critical value for 95% confidence interval determination

# initialize matrices for simulation results
HS_C14_matrix <- matrix(nrow = SimNum, ncol = length(RSD))
APS_C14_matrix <- matrix(nrow = SimNum, ncol = length(RSD))
Slope_C14_matrix <- matrix(nrow = SimNum, ncol = length(RSD))
HSsd_C14_matrix <- matrix(nrow = SimNum, ncol = length(RSD))
APSsd_C14_matrix <- matrix(nrow = SimNum, ncol = length(RSD))
Slopesd_C14_matrix <- matrix(nrow = SimNum, ncol = length(RSD))

newdata1 <- data.frame(x = 1) # creates prediction data for HS endmember
newdata0 <- data.frame(x = 0)# creates prediction data for APS endmember

# Monte Carlo Simulation. May take a while to run

for(j in RSD){
  
  for(i in 1:SimNum){
    x <- rtnorm(length(RegressionData$HS), mean = RegressionData$HS, sd = j*RegressionData$HS, lower = 0, upper = 1)
    
    m <- lm(RegressionData$C14 ~ x)
    
    pred1 <- predict(m, newdata = newdata1, se.fit = TRUE)
    
    HS_C14_matrix[i,c]   <- pred1$fit
    HSsd_C14_matrix[i,c] <- tcrit * pred1$se.fit
    
    pred0 <- predict(m, newdata = newdata0, se.fit = TRUE)
    
    APS_C14_matrix[i,c]   <- pred0$fit
    APSsd_C14_matrix[i,c] <- tcrit * pred0$se.fit
    
    Slope_C14_matrix[i,c] <- coef(m)[2]
    Slopesd_C14_matrix[i,c] <- tcrit * sqrt(diag(vcov(m)))[2]
  }
  c=c+1
}

# Removes unneeded variables
rm(list = c('i','m','c','j', 'x','length'))
```

Calculate Error Threshold for the Slope
```{r}
reg14C = lm(RegressionData$C14~RegressionData$HS)
Slope_ttest_C14 =  matrix(nrow = length(RSD), ncol = 1)

# perform t-test for all random error levels to determine which level deviates significantly from linear regression
for (j in 1:length(RSD)){
  test=tsum.test(mean.x = mean(Slope_C14_matrix[,j]),
                 s.x = sd(Slope_C14_matrix[,j]),
                 n.x = SimNum,
                 mean.y = reg14C$coefficients[2],
                 s.y = sqrt(diag(vcov(reg14C)))[2],
                 n.y = length(RegressionData$C14))
  Slope_ttest_C14[j]=test$p.value
}

# Removes unneeded variables
rm(list=c('j', 'test'))
```

Graph of Slope vs Error
```{r}
# Finds the mean and standard of the monte carlo simulated values for each error increment
mSlope = colMeans(Slope_C14_matrix)
sdSlope = apply(Slope_C14_matrix, 2, sd)

Slope_14C = ggplot()+
  geom_point(aes(x = RSD, y = mSlope))+
  geom_line(aes(x = RSD, y = mSlope))+
  geom_errorbar(aes(x = RSD, y = mSlope, ymin = mSlope-sdSlope, ymax = mSlope+sdSlope), width = cap_width)+
  geom_rect(aes(xmin =RSD[match(max(Slope_ttest_C14[Slope_ttest_C14<0.05]),Slope_ttest_C14)], 
                ymin = min(mSlope-sdSlope),
                xmax = 0.35, ymax = max(mSlope+sdSlope)),
            fill = 'maroon',alpha = .2 )+
  annotate("text", x = 0, y = max(mSlope+sdSlope), label = "E", hjust = 0, size = labelsize)+
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(0,.1,.2,.3),
                     labels = c(0,10,20,30))+
  theme_classic()+
  theme(axis.title = element_text(size = titlesize),
    axis.text = element_text(size  = axis_text))+
  labs(x = 'Percent Relative Error on HS Content', y = "Slope")

Slope_14C

```

Graph of Slope Error vs Error
```{r}
# Finds the mean and standard of the monte carlo simulated values for each error increment
mSlopesd = colMeans(Slopesd_C14_matrix)
sSlopesd = apply(Slopesd_C14_matrix, 2, sd)

Slope_error_14C = ggplot()+
  geom_point(aes(x = RSD, y = mSlopesd))+
  geom_line(aes(x = RSD, y = mSlopesd))+
  geom_errorbar(aes(x = RSD, y = mSlopesd, ymin = mSlopesd-sSlopesd, ymax = mSlopesd+sSlopesd),
                width = cap_width)+
  annotate("text", x = 0, y = max(mSlopesd+sSlopesd), label = "F", hjust = 0, size = labelsize)+
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(0,.1,.2,.3),
                     labels = c(0,10,20,30))+
  theme_classic()+
  theme(axis.title = element_text(size = titlesize),
    axis.text = element_text(size  = axis_text))+
  labs(x = 'Percent Relative Error on HS Content', y = "Error in Slope")

Slope_error_14C
```

Calculate Error Threshold for the HS Endmember
```{r}
HS_ttest_C14 =  matrix(nrow = length(RSD), ncol = 1)

# perform t-test for all random error levels to determine which level deviates significantly from linear regression
for (j in 1:length(RSD)){
  test=tsum.test(mean.x = mean(HS_C14_matrix[,j]),
                 s.x = sd(HS_C14_matrix[,j]),
                 n.x = SimNum,
                 mean.y = reg14C$coefficients[2]+reg14C$coefficients[1],
                 s.y = sqrt(vcov(reg14C)[1,1] + vcov(reg14C)[2,2] + 2 * vcov(reg14C)[1,2]), #determines standard deviation on HS endmember
                 n.y = length(RegressionData$C14))
  HS_ttest_C14[j]=test$p.value
}

# Removes unneeded variables
rm(list=c('j', 'test'))
```

```{r}

  geom_point(aes(x = RSD, y = mHS))+
  geom_line(aes(x = RSD, y = mHS))+
  geom_errorbar(aes(x = RSD, y = mHS, ymin = mHS-sdHS, ymax = mHS+sdHS), width = cap_width)+
  geom_rect(aes(xmin =RSD[match(max(HS_ttest_C14[HS_ttest_C14<0.05]),HS_ttest_C14)], 
                ymin = min(mHS-sdHS),
                xmax = 0.35, ymax = max(mHS+sdHS)),
            fill = 'maroon',alpha = .2 )+
  annotate("text", x = 0, y = max(mHS+sdHS), label = "C", hjust = 0, size = labelsize)+
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(0,.1,.2,.3),
                     labels = c(0,10,20,30))+
  theme_classic()+
  theme(axis.title = element_text(size = titlesize),
    axis.title.x = element_blank(),
    axis.text = element_text(size  = axis_text))+
```

Combine Graphs and Save as .png
```{r}
sensitivity_plots_14C = plot_grid(APS_14C, APS_error_14C, HS_14C, HS_error_14C, Slope_14C,  Slope_error_14C,  nrow = 3)
sensitivity_plots_14C

ggsave(plot = sensitivity_plots_14C,
       filename = "Sensitivity Plots 14C.png",
       path = "<file path>", #change to path where you want file stored
       width = 180,
       height = 202,
       unit = 'mm',
       dpi = 300) 
```

Combine Graphs and Save as .png
```{r}
sensitivity_plots_13C = plot_grid(APS_13C, APS_error_13C, HS_13C, HS_error_13C, Slope_13C,  Slope_error_13C,  nrow = 3)
sensitivity_plots_13C

ggsave(plot = sensitivity_plots_13C,
       filename = "Sensitivity Plots 13C.png",
       path = "<file path>", #change to path where you want file stored
       width = 180,
       height = 202,
       unit = 'mm',
       dpi = 300) 
```
